_comment: What a reader can say, and what LIA must understand. Grouped by FAMILY: the parameters and the expected firings are language-independent, only the phrasing changes, so each expectation is written ONCE and checked against six utterances. `expect` holds LOCAL wall clocks in the family's own zone, because a reader can verify those by eye and a UTC instant they cannot. Two consumers: the deterministic test (params -> spec -> instants, in CI, no network) and the on-demand measurement (utterance -> params, through a real model).
reference_note: 2026-09-06 is a SUNDAY. Anchors default to that local date.

families.why: The post-it. What every reminder was before recurrence existed.
An explicit calendar date, months ahead.

utterances.es: el 3 de marzo de 2027 a las 8

families.why: TWICE A DAY - the shape the three cron columns could never express.

utterances.es: todos los días a las 8 y a las 18
utterances.it: tutti i giorni alle 8 e alle 18

families.why: Both axes at once: chosen days AND several moments inside them.

utterances.fr: tous les lundis et jeudis à 8h et 18h
utterances.en: every Monday and Thursday at 8am and 6pm

utterances.zh: 每周一和周四上午8点和下午6点

families.why: A named set. 'En semaine' must not become five separate weeklies.
The other named set, and the one a model most often mis-numbers.

utterances.es: los fines de semana a las 10

families.why: An INTERVAL, not a day-of-month. The classic mis-transcription.

utterances.es: un martes de cada dos a las 9

families.why: 'Tous les 3 jours' is an interval; 'le 3 du mois' is a day-of-month. The anchor matters as much: described at noon, a 07:30 schedule starts TOMORROW, not in three days — a first firing one whole period away is not what anyone means.
TRAP: 'tous les 15 jours' is an interval of 15 DAYS, never the 15th. And it starts at its next slot, not fifteen days from now.
A day of month, which the trap above must NOT collapse into.

utterances.en: on the 15th of every month at 9am
utterances.es: el 15 de cada mes a las 9

families.why: 'The 2nd Tuesday' is not a day of month at all.

families.why: A series that stops after N firings - counted in INSTANTS. The trap is the anchor: 'the next 3 times' means three FUTURE ones, so a faithful transcription starts on the first day whose slot has not passed. Anchored on today, this series would hold only two.

utterances.fr: tous les jours à 8h, les 3 prochaines fois
utterances.en: every day at 8am, the next 3 times
utterances.de: jeden Tag um 8 Uhr, die nächsten 3 Male
utterances.es: todos los días a las 8, las próximas 3 veces
utterances.it: tutti i giorni alle 8, le prossime 3 volte

families.why: A STEP inside a window - many firings a day from one sentence. The reference instant sits INSIDE the window, so the day it is read on still has slots left; a schedule does not start tomorrow just because it was described today.

utterances.es: cada 2 horas entre las 9 y las 17
utterances.it: ogni 2 ore tra le 9 e le 17
utterances.zh: 上午9点到下午5点每2小时一次

families.why: TRAP: the 31st exists in seven months only; the others are SKIPPED, never shifted.
